request.query: Bound the factorial coefficient envelope in Roth's theorem by a slightly larger power of a large denominator q

items.name: Behrend.bound_aux'
items.type: ∀ (n d : ℕ), ↑(d ^ n) / ↑(n * d ^ 2) ≤ ↑(rothNumberNat ((2 * d - 1) ^ n))

items.name: Nat.choose_le_pow_div
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Semifield α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] (r n : ℕ),
  ↑(n.choose r) ≤ ↑n ^ r / ↑r.factorial

items.name: Behrend.bound_aux
items.type: ∀ {n d : ℕ}, d ≠ 0 → 2 ≤ n → ↑d ^ (n - 2) / ↑n ≤ ↑(rothNumberNat ((2 * d - 1) ^ n))

items.name: Nat.pow_le_choose
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Semifield α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] (r n : ℕ),
  ↑(n + 1 - r) ^ r / ↑r.factorial ≤ ↑(n.choose r)
